case_set_definition: all = every case; dvt_yes / dvt_no = cases whose DVT_Presence in /LARGE0/gr10478/b37974/Pulmonary_Hypertension/cteph_agp3k.v6/info/cteph_agp3k.v6.20260507.xlsx is Yes / No (Unknown or blank: in 'all' only); these three against all of the cohort's controls. dvt_case_only = the dvt_yes and dvt_no cases only, no controls, PHENO1 recoded 1 = DVT yes / 0 = DVT no: the test of a difference between the two
cohort_nesting: narrow_mainland is a strict subset of intermediate_mainland is a strict subset of full_mainland; they differ mainly in controls. Agreement across cohorts is a sample-selection sensitivity analysis, not replication.
markers: hla.typing.v2 results/06.assoc_inputs/<cohort>/{allele,residue}_dosage.tsv, read unchanged (md5 checked against summary.json); 2-field alleles and amino-acid residues at IMGT positions; 0/1/2 copies, blank = undetermined
coding: VCF hard calls, REF A = copy does not carry the marker, ALT P = copy carries it; effects are per copy carrying the marker
positions: chromosome 6, gene start (RefSeq hg38_refGene, union of chr6 transcripts) + rank of the marker within its gene; labels, not physical residue positions
fixed_model: logistic regression per marker (scripts/logit_scan.py: Newton-Raphson to convergence, Wald test, no Firth) on the 12_model_inputs fixed_model sample set (relatives removed) restricted to the case set; SEX + 10 PCs; complete case per marker. plink2 --glm was replaced because its logistic fit stops short of the MLE for some markers depending on file context
random_model: SAIGE step 2 (--LOCO=TRUE --chrom=6 --AlleleOrder=alt-first --is_Firth_beta=FALSE --impute_method=mean --maxMissing=0.15 --minMAC=0.5) on the case set's samples
null_models: all: analysis/assoc_saige 'main' null model, reused. dvt_yes / dvt_no / dvt_case_only: fitted here with SAIGE step 1 (binary, full GRM, LOCO, isDiagofKinSetAsOne, 200 variance-ratio markers, SEX + 10 PCs) on the random_model genotypes restricted to analysis/assoc_saige 00.prep/grm.prune.in and the case set's samples. Every null model checked against its case set (CHECK_NULL).
random_model_p: p = p.value.NA (no SPA), as in the genome-wide SAIGE scan; p_spa = p.value kept as a secondary column; se = 1/sqrt(var), consistent with p.value.NA; OR = exp(BETA)
significance: Per (case set, cohort, class, model): Bonferroni p < 0.05 / markers tested; Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 over the same family (missing P counted as 1). Not corrected across case sets, cohorts or models. lambda_GC reported, never applied.
conditional: per (case set, cohort, model), with the scan's own engine on a pooled PLINK set (alleles + residues + the GWAS MHC lead[s] + a SENTINEL first record that absorbs a SAIGE --condition defect on the first marker): (1) stepwise over HLA markers, entry P < 0.05 / (alleles + residues), step 1 always run, at most 5 steps; (2) every HLA marker given each lead; (3) each lead given single HLA markers (top 10 by |r|, top 10 by marginal P, stepwise leads) and given the entered leads jointly
gwas_leads: analysis/assoc_saige 'main' (SAIGE, SEX + 10 bbj_mainland PCs, p.value.NA): peaks overlapping chr6:28510120-33480577 whose lead has P < 0.00001 in every cohort; genotypes from 12_model_inputs random_model. Missing lead calls are mean-imputed here (best_guess in the genome-wide scan), so the lead's marginal P here differs slightly from the scan's
independence: designed and run without reading any file, script, null model or result of analysis/assoc_hla
figures: results/<case_set>/figures/0N.<family>/, four families per case set, one README.md per family; results/_case_sets/dvt_contrast.png + README.md
